name_status: named by the sheet (WREN, Oakvale Village)
units: metres; floor z = 0 at the soles

lip_seal.rule: front rays deeper than 2.5 mm behind the lip front = the gap; half the gap closed from each lip, falloff 9.0 mm, overlap 0.30 mm

eye_scale.shape_dev_rule: distance (mm) of each vertex after the scale to the unscaled (v2) surface; zones in the unscaled frame; 'outside_socket_core' = outer skin beyond the full-scale core

undereye.rule: front-ray profiles down 5 columns under each eye; depth = max sink behind the profile's front convex hull (mm)

relief_vs_fit_mm.rule: max |offset| of the lip-zone core's front surface from the per-column no-lip profile fit (proud lips and the seam crease alike)

eye_proof.rule: front rays on a 0.25 mm grid: iris coverage = iris-family hits / eyeball hits (the visible opening); poke = eyeball vertices > 0.3 mm outside the OUTER skin (the nearest skin point faces away from the ball's centre) beyond the opening's projection

brow.rule: front view: at stations t along the stroke, the longest run of rays whose first hit is a brow face

hidden_skin_removed.enclosed_rule: every vertex's rays toward 12 front / tactical directions hit body or eyeball within 8 cm

facing.rule: head centre (between the eyes, at the skull's mid depth) -> nose tip (midline)

face_zone.rule: body skin faces (skin, skin_shadow, lips, mouth, liner, brow, lash) with every vertex head- or neck_01-dominant

tier_rationale: HERO role: window [30000, 50000]. The MPFB body (face, hands, fingers for the grip) + a real hair mass + a patched two-tone cloak with hood + cowl + boots + the outfit pieces + a detailed pitchfork.
open_edges_rule: every part is a closed solid (listed here only if not); the body is the MPFB skin

cap_feather.rule: cap outer thickness x smoothstep(0, 0.022, height above the hairline), floor 0.0022 m

slivers.rule: faces under SLIVER_AREA collapse their shortest edge (3 passes)

crown.rule: highest hair vertex (cap + every clump but the cowlick) minus the MPFB scalp top; vampwarrior v4.2: 8.5 mm (v4 23.3 mm = 'too tall'); v2 14.4 mm

bake.high_rule: MPFB body at subdivision 1 (smooth) + every part

normal_skin_only.rule: normal texels outside the (dilated) skin-region UV triangles set flat

decode_vs_proxy_deg_p50_p90_p99.note: a tangent-space map can only turn a facet within its own hemisphere: underside facets (facing the scalp, painted hair_shade) cannot take a proxy normal > 90 deg away

hair_proxy_bake.v2: the strip was flat (0.5, 0.5, 1): every facet lit by its own face normal

hair_strip.rule: hair faces packed into u > 0.86; normal texels there flat, AO texels white
